title: Tlamo e Ngotsoeng Botjha ke Tšenolo
intro: Ak'u inahanele u tšepetsoe motho oa bohlokoa haholo, ebe u tobana le taelo e felisang tlamo ka lebaka la kutlo. Tšenolo e ile ea fetola lelapa lohle, 'me lebitso le bohareng ba taelo ha ea ka ea e-ba lona le neng le bitsoa.
clues: Ke ile ka ema moo botšepehi ba motho ka mong bo neng bo lokela ho inehela kutlong ea bomolimo.
Ke ne ke tsebahala lapeng la Moromuoa ke le mora ea nketsoeng lapeng.
Ke ile ka ithuta hore lenyalo la ka le ile la fetoha taba ea tšenolo e lebisitsoeng ho Moromuoa oa Allah.
Ke utloile mantsoe a reng, 'Boloka mosali oa hao 'me u tšabe Allah,' a lebisitsoe ho 'na.
Eaba ke ithuta hore Allah o laetse Moromuoa oa Allah ho hlala basali ba itseng, 'me lenyalo la ka le ile la tlameha ho fela tlas'a taelo eo.
Ke 'na Zayd ibn Harithah, mora ea nketsoeng ka lapeng ea bitsoang Surah Al-Ahzb.

identity.label: Ke mang?
options: Zayd ibn Harithah
Moprofeta Harun
Moprofeta Yahya
Lengeloi la Lefu
Barab'abo Yusuf

trial.label: Nyeoe/Ketsahalo
options: Ho bolelloa hore a boloke mosali oa hae ebe o laeloa hore a mo hlale
Ho metsoa ke tlhapi e kholo
Ho lahleloa ka sebōping sa mollo
Ho robala ka hare ho lehaha ka makholo a lilemo
Ho tobana le noha ka lere
trial.answer: Ho bolelloa hore a boloke mosali oa hae ebe o laeloa hore a mo hlale

location.label: Karolo ea Bohlokoa
options: Lelapa la Moromuoa oa Allah
Ntlo ea borena ea Faro Egepeta
Lehaha la metsoalle e robetseng
Serapa sa metsoalle e 'meli ea balumeli
Ntlo ea borena e sirelelitsoeng ea Qarun

outcome.label: Sephetho
options: O ile a mamela taelo, a hlala mosali oa hae, 'me lenyalo la qhaloa
O ile a pholosoa a sa tsoa kotsi seboping sa mollo
O ile a pholosoa ka mor'a ho metsoa ke tlhapi e kholo
Ke ile ka fuoa serapa se nang le liliba tse peli
O ile a fuoa puso holim'a Bochabela le Bophirima
outcome.answer: O ile a mamela taelo, a hlala mosali oa hae, 'me lenyalo la qhaloa

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
